name: Jotform Apps
description:
Create and customize fully functional apps directly in Claude. Simply describe what you want to build, and Jotform Apps generates a ready-to-use app that you can refine through conversation. Customize layouts, add forms and widgets, manage users and permissions, configure payments and workflows, and publish your app—all without coding or leaving the chat.

You can use the Jotform Apps connector to:

Create apps with natural language:
""Create a client portal where customers can submit requests, access resources, and track important information""

Customize existing apps:
""Open my 'Employee Onboarding' app and add a welcome page, onboarding form, and resource section for new hires""

Configure and publish apps:
""Update my 'Event App' with attendee registration, payment collection, and event resources, then get it ready to share""

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jotform Apps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jotform Apps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jotform.com/mcp-jotform-apps-v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jotform Apps MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jotform Apps provides these MCP tools: create_app, edit_app, fetch, get_teams, search, and mcp_app_request.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jotform Apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jotform Apps in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Jotform Apps MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jotform Apps requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jotform Apps is developed by Jotform Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
